description: Create a behavioral spec. The first run after creation sets the baseline output; subsequent scheduled runs are scored against that baseline across 5 axes (semantic, format, refusal, length, contains). An alert is sent when the drift score crosses the threshold.

frequency.description: How often to run the spec.

name.description: Spec label, e.g. 'Refusal canary' or 'JSON schema check'.

prompt.description: The exact prompt to send to the model.

threshold.description: Severity at which to fire an alert. Buckets: low ≥0.05, medium ≥0.15, high ≥0.35, critical ≥0.6.

name: create_spec
